The '''Killik Praetor''' was an oversized [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] that lived on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It and its nest were used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Nefarid]] to [[Attack on the Mensaav Military Laboratory|attack]] the [[Mensaav Military Laboratory|Mensaav Laboratory]], and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] was forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the crazed insectoid with his [[Hero of Tython|former student]] in the aftermath of the attack.
